description: Change of use of part single and part two storey commercial building to 3 bedroom house, together with ground floor entrance canopy, first floor extension, bin store extension and other alterations.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extensions permitted and the other alterations to the existing building have first been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. These details of materials shall include all details of fenestration/glazing panels/rooflights. The development shall only be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until full details of the obscure glazing for each of the obscurely glazed areas, including the glassblock window, have first been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, and the development shall only be carried out in accordance with the approved details and retained as such.  In addition, the obscure glazing shall be fixed shut/non-openable and thereafter retained as such.

Condition : 4 - No additional external openings including any doors or windows or other glazed areas shall be formed in any elevation of the application building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding the detail of the first floor window in the west facing elevation shown on the submitted plan 2007/76/P01 Revision B, no development shall take place until details have first been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority showing the window fixed shut except for a small top opening.  This window shall be provided as approved on the implementation of the development and shall thereafter be retained as such.

Condition : 6 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - Notwithstanding the provisions of Classes A, B, C, D and E of Part 1 of Schedule 2 to the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995, no additions or extensions to the dwellinghouse including to its roof, or alterations to the shape of the roof, or the erection of any porch outside any external door of the dwellinghouse, or any building or enclosure within the curtilage of the dwellinghouse, shall be carried out without the prior permission in writing of the Local Planning Authority, obtained through the submission of a planning application.

Condition : 8 - The car parking provision shown on Drawing No. 2007/76/P01 Revision B for the proposed new residential unit shall be provided before the residential unit to which it relates is first occupied, and thereafter it shall not be used for any purpose other than the parking of vehicles.

Condition : 9 - The area of garden/amenity space as shown on Drawing No. 2007/76/P01 Revision B shall be provided as indicated prior to the first occupation of the development, and shall thereafter be retained.
Condition : 10 - No part of the roof of the building shall be altered or adapted for use as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 11 - Details of all boundary walls and fences shall be submitted to and shall be approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of the development, and the approved details shall be implemented as approved and shall thereafter be retained.

Condition : 12 - Notwithstanding the details of the internal layout of the residential unit as submitted, no development shall take place until details have first been submitted to, and have been approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority showing the ground floor of the house accessible for an ambulant disabled person, and in accordance with the requirements for Lifetime Homes, and the development shall only be implemented in accordance with the terms of the consent.

Condition : 13 - No development shall take place until details have been submitted to and have been approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority for a scheme of acoustic insulation to ensure the maximum noise level to be permitted within the dwelling with windows shut and any other necessary means of ventilation provided shall not exceed the "reasonable" limits contained in BS8233:1999. These being LAeq,16hour = 40 dB in living rooms, and a night(07:00 - 23:00) LAeq,8hour = 35 dB and LAFmax = 45 dB in bedrooms, and a night LAeq,1hour = 45 dB in Kitchens, Bathrooms and Utility Rooms ". The details shall be carried out as approved.

Condition : 14 - Before the development hereby permitted commences the applicant must either:a.	Investigate the site for landfill gas to the satisfaction of the LPA, to ascertain whether gas protection measures are required.  Where measures are required the details shall be submitted to, and approved by, the LPA.Or;b.	The applicant shall install gas protection measures as a precautionary measure without first investigating the site.  The details of these measures shall be submitted to, and approved by, the LPA.c.	For a. and b. all required measures shall be installed before the development is first occupied.
